quality.meaning: constellation EVM after fixed integrate-and-dump; it is not BER without known reference bits.

limitations: No framing, CRC, FEC, encryption, differential decoding, equalisation, or protocol recognition is performed.
Timing is a manual fixed integrate-and-dump override, not a recovered clock.
Hard bits are candidate decisions, not validated payload data.
